result_text:
I fixed the four broken default conventions in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. The `codeanalyzer` tests pass. I didn't add new tests, so the fixed patterns themselves haven't been run against sample files.

- **Generated HTML rules (pkgdown, Doxygen, meta generator):** the extension group was `(html|html|xhtml)`, so I changed it to `(html|htm|xhtml)`. `.htm` pages now match, and `.html` and `.xhtml` still do.
- **`// Generated by …` JavaScript rule and `<doc>` XML rule:** the path patterns were `.*/[.]js` and `.*/[.]xml`, which only match a file literally named `.js` or `.xml`. They are now `.*[.]js` and `.*[.]xml`, so `app.js` and `MyAssembly.xml` match.
- **Gradle JavaScript rule:** `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` became `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` lands in build-and-deployment. The `*.gradle` rule is unchanged, so `build.gradle` still matches.

The content patterns weren't touched, so hand-written `.htm`, `.js` and `.xml` files stay out of these scopes unless they contain the generator markers.

The `<doc>` rule matches only a line that is exactly `<doc>`, as before. An indented or otherwise padded `<doc>` line wouldn't match.
